(54) Title: RF BASED MONITORING OF USER ACTIVITY 30 E U"W Dat 1 ~ ~ English English

(57) Abstract: Methods and apparatus, including computer program products, are provided for activity tracking. In some example embodiments, there may be provided a method that includes deriving, from radio frequency based data, pseudo sensor data representative of at least an activity of a user, the pseudo sensor data derived based on at least a machine learning model configured to transform the radio frequency based data into the pseudo sensor data; and providing the pseudo sensor data. Related systems, methods, and articles of manufacture are also described.
